We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: three steps enumerated in order they must be applied (forward). Steps: 1) Carboxylic acid to amide via coupling (amide formation). 2) Doebner modification to form α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (C=C formation). 3) Sulfonamide formation from amine and sulfonyl chloride.

Thus retrosynthetic order: start from target, break amide bond to give carboxylic acid and aniline (or amine). Then break the α,β-unsaturated acid to give aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid. So retro: break the C=C and carboxylic acid to give aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid (or its derivative). Then sulfonamide formation: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride and aniline.

Thus final precursors: (1) aniline (p-tolyl amine?) Actually target has a tolyl sulfonamide attached to phenyl ring. The sulfonamide is NS(=O)(=O) attached to a phenyl ring (para-methyl phenyl). So sulfonamide formation: sulfonyl chloride (p-tolylsulfonyl chloride) + aniline (the other aromatic amine). The aniline is the phenyl ring bearing the unsaturated amide side chain (the second phenyl). Actually structure: p-tolyl (CH3 on phenyl) attached to N of sulfonamide, which is attached to another phenyl (c2ccc(... )cc2). That second phenyl has the α,β-unsaturated amide side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N-aryl (aniline). So the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the second phenyl (the one bearing the side chain). So sulfonamide formation: p-tolylsulfonyl chloride + aniline (the second phenyl with side chain). So retro: target -> separate into p-tolylsulfonyl chloride and the aniline bearing the side chain.

Then amide formation: the side chain is C=O N-aryl (anilide). So break amide to give carboxylic acid (α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So retro: unsaturated acid + aniline.

Then Doebner: unsaturated acid derived from aldehyde + malonic acid. So break to give aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring c2ccc... with aldehyde at position where side chain attaches) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). The aldehyde is attached to the phenyl ring at the position where the side chain attaches (para to sulfonamide? Actually the side chain attaches at para position relative to sulfonamide? The SMILES: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So the phenyl ring has the side chain at para position relative to sulfonamide? Not needed.

Thus final three precursors: p-tolylsulfonyl chloride, aniline (c3ccccc3N), aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2), malonic acid.

We need to produce JSON route with three reaction nodes.

We need template IDs for each step. We can search for sulfonamide formation template (sulfonyl chloride + amine). Use search with functional_groups_formed: sulfonamides. Already we have template 733 etc. That template is for sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride and amine. Use template_id 733 (reaction_id 733). We'll use that.

For amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine). Search for amide formation template. Use search with functional_groups_formed: amide. Let's search.
